desc: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B — Qwen3.5-9B agentic distill finetune (MIT)

error: context type MTP requested but model doesn't contain MTP layers
note: the distill GGUF drops the Qwen3.5 nextn/MTP head — no speculative decoding available for this finetune; head-to-head must be no-draft vs MTP-d4

serve: -c 32768 -np 1 -ngl 999 -fa on -b 512 -ub 512 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 --jinja (no spec) — identical flags to the Qwen3.5-9B 32K registry config except the draft

warm_up_note: first request pays ~30 s graph compile; wall 8.2-9.4 s for 500 tokens steady
comparison: Qwen3.5-9B same ctx/KV/same prompt with d4 MTP: ~124 tok/s (100% acceptance on this repetitive prompt); MiMo is ~half that rate without a drafter

what: Qwen3.5-9B relaunched with identical no-draft flags (same engine, ctx 32K, q8_0 KV, same prompt, thinking off) to separate architecture-vs-MTP effect on decode
result: Qwen3.5-9B no-draft warm decode 62.0 tok/s (16.13 ms/token; 2 runs) vs MiMo 60.9-61.1 tok/s — IDENTICAL within noise
verdict: MiMo has zero per-token speed penalty vs its parent; its entire decode gap to Qwen3.5-9B's 124 tok/s (d4 MTP) is the dropped nextn/MTP head in the distill GGUF

idea: splice the parent Qwen3.5-9B's embedded MTP head (blk.32.nextn.eh_proj/enorm/hnorm/shared_head_norm + qwen35.nextn_predict_layers=1) into the MiMo GGUF (renamed blk.31.nextn for MiMo's block_count=32)
result: LOADS AND SERVES, but draft acceptance 0.00050-0.00400 (1-2 per ~2000 drafts) and decode DROPS to 25.8-27.0 tok/s vs 61 no-draft — every draft rejected, then paid for in verification
verdict: FALSIFIED: the distillation moved the output distribution beyond the parent's head; MiMo's missing MTP is not repairable by grafting — it would need its own trained head. No-draft 61 tok/s remains MiMo's honest ceiling; the parent 9B strictly dominates.
artifacts: grafted GGUF deleted after the measurement (34 MB .py splice script kept at notes/mimo_mtp_graft_attempt.py for reproduction)

what: re-baseline of the morning v2.1 headline (mimo-v2-suite 9/11 @763s): identical serve (32K, b512/ub512, q8_0 KV, unpinned, WARM_BYPASS with pi pre-clear), 11-task suite rerun label mimo-serial-c32k-q8kv-unpinned
result: 8/11, 1005s — task2-react-fix flipped P->F (503s fail vs morning PASS at 155s); everything else matches (task5/task8 fail both runs)
verdict: the 9/11 headline is reproducible within sampling variance (unpinned band = 8-9/11); the leaderboard rank survives, but the '9/11 ties the 9B' numbers should read as '8-9/11 band'. FAILS in one run can wander across runs — README caveat applies.
protocol_finding: task11-assign-seats passes BOTH unpinned runs (76-360s) and fails BOTH temperature-0-pinned runs (183-357s) — GREEDY PINNING COSTS TASK11 on this distill: temperature gives escape routes on the heavy iterative tasks. All drafter-pair A/Bs today remain valid (both arms pinned identically), but their absolute scores understate capability by 1-2 tasks. House note: pin before finality, but record that pinning biases iterative-failure-modes.
transient_note: three zero-byte pi batches occurred during the evening; the 32K unpinned replication itself needed 2 attempts (INVALID file kept). Root cause still unidentified — intermittently pi hangs before writing its session header, even while manual probes minutes before/after succeed; the strace trap armed on the clean run never fired.
